title: The 5 Tallest People Ever, Ranked (The Tallest Man Alive Is Only #5)

scenes.text: The five tallest people ever measured. The tallest man alive only ties for fifth.

scenes.label: Sultan Kösen · 251 cm
scenes.text: Number five: Sultan Kösen of Türkiye. 251 centimeters, just under eight foot three, the tallest man alive.

scenes.label: Bernard Coyne · 254 cm
scenes.text: Number four: Bernard Coyne, an American. 254 centimeters, eight foot four, and still growing when he died at 23.

scenes.label: John Carroll · 263.5 cm
scenes.text: Number three: John Carroll of Buffalo. Eight foot seven, but his spine curved so much he stood under eight feet.

scenes.label: John Rogan · 267 cm
scenes.text: Number two: John Rogan. Eight foot nine. He couldn't stand, so doctors measured him sitting down.

scenes.label: Robert Wadlow · 272 cm
scenes.text: Number one: Robert Wadlow of Illinois. Eight foot eleven, 272 centimeters, at 22. And he was still growing.

description:
The five tallest people ever reliably measured, ranked by the heights Guinness World Records accepts.
Robert Wadlow of Alton, Illinois, was 272 cm (8 ft 11.1 in) when last measured on 27 June 1940, weeks before he died at 22. John Rogan's 267 cm was worked out from measurements taken while he was seated. John Carroll's 263.5 cm is adjusted for a severely curved spine; standing, he measured 243.8 cm. Bernard Coyne reached 254 cm, and Sultan Kösen, the tallest living man, is 251 cm, the same height recorded for Finland's Väinö Myllyrinne, who died in 1963. Taller claims exist, but none was verified.
Did you expect the tallest man alive to be only fifth?
first_comment: Robert Wadlow wore size 37AA shoes, 47 cm long. Who would you have guessed at number one, and what should we rank next?
